items.hook: Dogs are susceptible to the bouba-kiki effect
items.body: Just like humans, dogs seem to associate the nonsense word “bouba” with a rounded shape and “kiki” with a spiky shape, suggesting the connection stems from brain mechanisms that are shared between species
